privateAddress.needsPermission: {{origin}} is on a private network, so lifeGLANCE needs your permission to connect to it. The server has not been contacted yet.
privateAddress.refused: {{origin}} is a reserved address that lifeGLANCE will not connect to.
privateAddress.allowHint: lifeGLANCE will ask you to confirm. Only allow addresses on your own network.
privateAddress.consentQuestion: Allow lifeGLANCE to connect to this address?
privateAddress.consentResolvesTo: It resolves to a private network address:
privateAddress.consentWarning: Only allow this if it is your own server, on your own network (a home or office LAN, a Docker host, or a VPN such as Tailscale). lifeGLANCE will be able to reach it, and anything it returns becomes part of your data.
privateAddress.consentWarningLoopbackVault: This address is a service running on this computer. Only allow it if it is your own GLANCEvault and the port is the one it listens on. Other programs on this machine are reachable at other ports, and this permission does not cover them.
privateAddress.consentWarningLoopbackServer: This address is a service running on this computer. Only allow it if it is your own sync server and the port is the one it listens on. Other programs on this machine are reachable at other ports, and this permission does not cover them.
privateAddress.consentScope: This applies to this one address only. You can remove it later in Cloud Sync.
